package.welcome_message: Welcome to a 4-day family adventure through Amman, Karak, and Tafilah - a journey that blends history, culture, and Jordanian hospitality.

trip.title: Amman · Karak · Tafilah
trip.summary: Four days of immersive cultural exploration: start with a relaxed arrival in Amman, then two days of religious and museum highlights in Karak, and finish with a scenic and historic day in Tafilah. Each day stays within one region, with outdoor visits in the morning and shaded or indoor activities in the afternoon to beat the August heat.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Karak (2 days), then Tafilah. Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 3 places to visit and 3 meals on exploring days. The arrival day follows the time that remains after food and rest.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.why: 3 exploring days is too short for both the north and the south.
